reviews.raw_body:
Thanks, I've added this to mm-new.

I'd previous added v5 but it never really got testing exposure due to a
messy interaction with other changes which I didn't get onto fixing.

2026-09-20.patch_summary: This patch series improves the testing of khugepaged, a Linux kernel feature that collapses huge pages to smaller ones. The existing tests were incomplete and had issues such as not being able to detect where a collapse landed or exercising collapse under contention. This patch series addresses these gaps by making the suite run at larger PMD sizes, detecting results per window rather than count, driving khugepaged deterministically, covering collapse at every supported order, and racing against sources that can touch its sources. The patches have been tested on an unmodified kernel and all tests pass.
